items.name: Barrel Disguise
items.description: Disguise yourself as a Barrel, significantly reduces aggro range but reduces movement speed. You can perform a barrel roll stunning any enemy that you roll into. Rolling into a solid object stuns you instead. Taking any damage breaks the effect. Produced at a Woodworking Bench.
items.acquisition: Barrel Disguise is a consumable item in V Rising. The crafting recipe becomes available after defeating Baron du Bouchon the Sommelier, and it can be crafted using the . When used, after a short channeling time, it disguises the player while consuming the item. It has the effect of significantly reducing enemy aggro range and player movement speed, while also granting immunity to sunlight during its usage. Utilizing Waygates or interacting within your territory doesn't break the disguise, but taking damage or interacting with structures like chests and containers outside of your territory will end the effect. Additionally, the Barrel Disguise replaces the player's abilities with the Barrel Roll ability, allowing them to perform a barrel roll. When rolling into an enemy, they are stunned for a duration ranging from 1 to 5 seconds. It's worth noting that this stun effect doesn't affect V Blood Carriers, only enemies. If the player accidentally rolls into a solid object, they are stunned for the same duration. In both scenarios, the barrel disguise is broken, and the player reverts to their normal state.

items.acquisition: Cursed Saplings are a Sapling which can be rarely found when destroying regular trees in the Cursed Forest area. These trees are the thinner, spindly ones found throughout the area. Counterintuitively, Cursed Saplings are not dropped from Cursed Trees, which only drop Cursed Wood. Cursed Saplings can be planted in player territory through the hotbar. Once selected it will bring up the build menu, allowing it to be planted in an empty . Fully grown Cursed saplings grant when harvested.

items.acquisition: Cypress Saplings are a Sapling which are sometimes dropped when destroying Cypress Trees. Cypress Trees can primarily be found in the Dunley Monastery, in front of the gates and throughout the front half of the Monastery. A smaller number can be found at the entrance and bridge to the Horse Track in the Dunley Farmlands. Fewer still can be found in front of the Fortress of Light in Silverlight Hills. Cypress Saplings have a higher-than-average droprate compared to other saplings due to the limited number of natural spawns. Cypress Saplings can be planted in player territory through the hotbar. Once selected it will bring up the build menu, allowing it to be planted in an empty .

items.acquisition: Dueling Banner is a unique item used for initiating duels, also known as Contests between 2 players. It can be initiated most places in the open world, and in player territories. Contests are risk-free, as instead of dying when your health is reduced to 0, you're instead restored to max health, meaning you do not drop a death bag or drain your Blood Pool / durability. The winner of the contest will be visually crowned temporarily. Is available on both PvE and PvP servers.

items.name: Jewels
items.description: Tier 4 Jewel
items.acquisition: Jewels are powerful magical artifacts that can be socketed into any non-ultimate spell to amplify and modify its effects. They can be equipped and replaced at any time with no cost associated, which encourages the player to experiment and swap their spell jewels. Spell jewels can only be socketed into unlocked spells, but will remain socketed after spell point resets at the . Jewels come in 4 tiers;Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, & Tier 4. Each tier corresponds to the number of modifiers it has. For example, Tier 2 Jewels will have 2 modifiers. Modifiers themselves also come in 5 tiers, though some unique modifiers only have 1 tier. It is speculated that higher tier Jewels possess a greater chance of rolling higher tier modifiers, but all Jewels can roll Tier 5 modifiers. They're always found in Golden Chests & Carriage containers, and commonly drop from V Blood Carriers, during Rift Incursions and rarely even regular enemies. No matter how they're acquired, the jewel's name, its modifiers, and their respective tiers are always randomized. Not to be confused with Jewelry.

items.acquisition: The Major Explosive Box is a recipe obtained from Angram the Purifier. This is the second raiding method players get access to. It is used to destroy stone structures by moving it to the hotbar and placing it down. Once the fuse is lit by any weapon attack or spell, including enemy attacks, it will explode after 3 seconds. It does 40% of a structure's max health in damage, meaning it requires 3 boxes to fully destroy a structure. Note that explosives can only damage stone structures after they have been breached by a . It can also be used for mining large resource deposits located throughout the map that can't be mined by traditional means, like maces. The MEB also has offensive and defensive uses in combat against players and monsters alike, however it is difficult to pull off.
